decisions: D-270 (300) (DP-0015) is the DC-300 plan at a ₱270 rate; it stays its own program (owner, October 8, 2026: option A). Its 261 accounts all pay ₱270 a month, which does not fit DC-300 at ₱300.
D-300 and D-300 (BRACKETING) are different programs. DC-300 is its own program.
Finalized on production (owner): D-180, D-190, D-230, D-280, D-290, D-300, D-300 (BRACKETING); their accounts are already in them, nothing to move.

D-290 (DAYONG 290) and DSP-290 are two programs, both with a 500 registration fee; DSP-290 began in August 2026. D-290 (500) belongs to D-290, except accounts enrolled from August 1, 2026, which are DSP-290 (owner, October 9, 2026; replaces the same day's mistaken all-to-DSP-290 move, undone on staging, never run on production). Program IDs are production's: DP-0021 is the real DSP-290, DP-0064 is D-290, and DP-0046 was a second program also named DSP-290 holding 2023 D-290 accounts (on staging DP-0046 is still named D-290 and DP-0064 does not exist, so run this on production).

Own programs, not moved (owner, October 10, 2026): D-390 (300) (another program; "(300)" marks its ₱300 registration fee in the old sheet), DC-180 (not D-180), D-270 (300) and DC-300 (not the same), D-320 (not chosen as DS-320).

Kept as separate programs (owner, October 10, 2026): D-350, D-350 (5Y) and DPB-350 are the same plan with different incentives, as are D-420 and DPB-420, so each stays its own program; D-460 and D-460 (59B) are different programs.
